scenario.normal.detail: Every path is up. Now and then a single sample fails, below the confirmation threshold, so it shows only as a warning.
scenario.dmit-blocked.detail: Public connections from Changsha and Hangzhou to DMIT time out while ICMP still answers and the tailnet relays through DERP; New York and Tokyo still get through → counter-evidence and a path-specific fault hypothesis. Clash falls back to S2.
scenario.dmit-down.detail: DMIT answers no observer, tailnet included; every primary chain breaks and the S2 backup chains take over.
scenario.aaitr-down.detail: Both chains through AAITR fail while the QQPR Hawaii exit still works → the exit candidates are degraded.
scenario.aaitr-exit-drift.detail: Requests succeed but the exit IP is outside the declared range → a policy violation, not an outage.
scenario.cross-border-loss.detail: Cross-border samples from mainland observers fail 35% of the time with latency ×2.6; states flap between warning and down.
scenario.home-offline.detail: The Windows and MacBook workers stop reporting (stale, then unknown, after a few tens of seconds); the Hangzhou reverse proxy cannot reach the home dashboard and visitors get a 502.
scenario.relay-down.detail: The whole Alibaba Cloud Hangzhou host is gone: the DERP relay, the reverse proxy and the Hangzhou observer disappear together.
scenario.s2-maintenance.detail: Checks involving S2 go into maintenance (no alerts); the backup line and the private services are not judged.
scenario.tokyo-clock-skew.detail: The Tokyo worker's clock runs 40 seconds fast; its samples are not taken as current results.
scenario.s1-origin-down.detail: S1 answers nothing: visitors get a 521 through Cloudflare while the edge keeps answering → the main site and API fail, but Cloudflare has evidence of answering and S1 is only marked affected; the New York observer goes offline with it.
scenario.edge-blocked.detail: Mainland observers cannot reach the Cloudflare edge (timeouts, no answer at all); Tokyo is served by NRT as usual → the fault lies before the edge and is not blamed on the origin.
scenario.chaos.detail: Every check breaks at random in 30-second windows (about 15%), with random latency spikes.
scenario.collector-unreachable.detail: The TUI gets no new snapshots: the cache is kept, but everything shows as unknown / CACHED.
node.win.notes: Clash Verge Rev (mihomo) + Tailscale; the home dashboard runs here
node.hz.notes: Self-hosted DERP relay + reverse proxy to the home devices
node.dmit.notes: Carries only the VLESS+Reality entry and runs nothing else
notes.residential-exit: Residential IP exit; carries only the proxy
node.s1.notes: The main web server, serving the public
node.s2.notes: Low-spec; private services stay private; doubles as the backup transit (S2 → exit)
node.cf.notes: Orange-cloud proxy for the main site and API (Full (strict) to origin S1); also runs the short-link Worker and the docs site on Pages
node.vercel.notes: Personal homepage on Next.js; static assets at the edge, functions in hnd1
node.supabase.notes: Managed Postgres + Auth, project region ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo)
observer.cs-win.context: Native Windows; Clash Verge TUN on. Explicit proxy checks use only the dedicated SOCKS listener, not the path ordinary programs take through TUN
observer.cs-mac.context: Native macOS; Clash Verge system proxy
observer.obs-hz.context: Mainland cloud baseline; reverse proxy on local loopback
observer.obs-s1.context: Overseas baseline; main site on local loopback
endpoint.dmit-entry.notes: VLESS+Reality entry port; a TCP connection is not proxy authentication
endpoint.s1-db-tn.notes: TCP is only a port check, not an SQL query
endpoint.supabase-rest.notes: REST gateway health; not an SQL query
service.backup-job.notes: Registered only; no heartbeat is faked without a real receipt check
notes.socks-listener: A dedicated SOCKS listener set up in Clash Verge beforehand; mihomo runs the inner VLESS+Reality chain, and Topophany neither creates nor switches it
path.egress.notes: Mirrors Clash Verge's fallback group; mihomo decides which one is actually selected, and this does not guess
path.j-hz.notes: The reverse proxy forwards to the home devices internally; the middle leg is not visible
check.j-home: Visitor to the home reverse proxy
